dedupe_keys.name: paris built and non built footprints emprises baties et non baties

description: Direction de l'Urbanisme, Ville de Paris publishes a vector layer that separates built footprints from non-built areas of Paris, with nature codes, source, creation and update dates, arrondissement and district identifiers and polygon area; a descriptive note is attached. Coverage: the city of Paris, France; about 495,000 polygons, record last modified on 2023-07-28. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the Paris open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Database License (ODbL); cost: free. Caveats: last modified in 2023 and no update frequency is stated; the descriptive note was not read. Simulation uses: impermeable-surface and building-footprint inputs for urban flood, heat-island and land-cover models. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
name: Paris: built and non-built footprints (Emprises bâties et non bâties)
notes: Round 2 piece 14 (no-public-data visits): round 1 marked "Ville de Paris, espaces verts (opendata.paris.fr)" as publishing no data; the portal was read on 2026-09-29.
